channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Myanmar army air strike kills dozens in Rakhine state
item.description: Nearly half a million people are displaced in Rakhine as a result of the conflict between the military and rebel groups.

item.title: Flights between Iraq’s Najaf and Iran resumed as Tehran protests US curbs
item.description: Tehran filed a UN complaint against US sanctions forcing regional cancellations of Iran flights.

item.title: Trump made the right decision to reject Iran’s offer
item.description: The US president has denied Tehran the opportunity to use the US midterm elections as a pressure point.

item.title: Iran touts Hormuz attacks as oil flows increase despite tensions
item.description: Mediators are trying to facilitate more talks, but Washington signals faith in its pressure tactics.

item.title: Photos: Russian drone strikes pound civilian targets across Kyiv
item.description: Ukraine condemns Russian targeting of civilians as strikes kill seven and injure dozens across Kyiv.

item.title: Paris court finds Swiftair guilty over 2014 Mali crash that killed 116
item.description: Spain's Swiftair was fined 225,000 euros in France for corporate manslaughter over 2014 Air Algerie disaster in Mali.

item.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
item.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

item.title: Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far
item.description: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".

item.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
item.description: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
item.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.
